title: What an agent may read
sub: AI and continuous architecture: an agent's context belongs on the map: the data products it may read, with their contracts and the glossary's terms, in a place of its own that holds nothing it may not read, reached by its own identity.
howto: Clay and lamp-light are Uruk, in 229 BCE: a scribe copying a tablet, and what he writes at its end. In the present, the map's six layers are glass in their colours, and a teal orb is an agent. A data product is a gold card with its contract; a coloured pill is its level, from public to restricted; the chat's place is a room of glass that holds only what it may read. Gold marks owners and the business side, cyan the technical side.
